text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek forces herself to race in<n>the Satsuki
Sho and miraculously<n>pulls off a victory.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She gives me total credit for her<n>winning what was
said to be a<n>hopeless race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She then praises me for being an<n>"amazing trainer."
